title: Store tap into a feature relay with ring and orbit
summary: A store listing is tapped, then the app answers in fast single-idea shots: twin phones swing in, a card flips, a chart counts up, a band types a claim, a ring fills, coins orbit a globe, and the wordmark wipes on. Each shot under 2.3 s.
use_when: A finance or wallet app launch that needs several capabilities shown in 15 s
Silent feed autoplay where each shot must carry one idea without VO
A store-download push: the film opens on the listing and the tap
Brands with one saturated accent per scene on black and white grounds

look.type_style: geometric grotesk, semibold, sentence case, normal tracking; headlines 4-6 % H, figures bold tabular 3 % H, sublines 1.5 % H

sfx.event: cursor presses the listing's action pill
twin phones swing in on Y
claim typed into the black band, per character
each coin appears on the orbit

structure.shot: store listing strip on black: app icon, name line with a subline, action pill; cursor enters and presses the pill
structure.camera: push-in: listing width 12 % W -> 35 % W 0.00-0.77 s, 37 % at 1.00, then pull back to 28 % at 1.27 (frames 0-40)
structure.motion: listing scale up on springs.cameraIn ~23 fr (overshoot not measurable); cursor-path from lower right 0.50-1.00 s, springs.click press at f30 (±0.25 s); listing recedes easings.inExpo 8 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: two phones with the app home screen (balance, round action buttons, list) side by side, one offset back, on black
structure.camera: pull-out: phones shrink and travel down 237 px/s @1920 from 2.00 s, scale -6 %/s
structure.motion: phones enter edge-on (Y ~85 deg at 1.50) and swing to a 3/4 view by 1.77 s on springs.heavy ~13 fr (±0.25 s); specular glint on the right phone's top corner at 1.77; 2.00-2.50 slow lean, then sink below frame easings.inExpo ~8 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: a gradient payment card (pink to blue, chip, small wordmark) alone on black
structure.camera: pull-out at the end: card width 25 % W at 3.50 -> 15 % W at 3.77 (zoom -32 %/s)
structure.motion: card slides down from the top edge at 2.77, then flips on Y: edge-on at 3.00, 3/4 at 3.27, near face-on at 3.50 (180 deg in ~22 fr, easings.inOutCubic, ±0.25 s); recedes 3.50-3.90 easings.inExpo

structure.shot: investment chart on black: big balance figure, small green delta line, a thin white wavy line chart, two small stat pairs below, pill badge top right
structure.camera: static 4.00-5.00, then slight drift left and scale down 5.00-5.27 (±0.25 s)
structure.motion: balance counter climbs 4.00-4.77 s (23 fr, easings.outExpo), then holds; line draws left to right 4.00-4.50 (15 fr, ±0.25 s) via chart-draw; stat figures count in sync with the balance; whole block fades to black 5.27-5.40 (~4 fr)

structure.shot: white frame with a full-width black band across the middle; a 3-word claim types inside the band in white
structure.motion: band opens at the cut at ~60 % H and settles to ~27 % H by 6.00 s (springs.layout ~17 fr, ±0.25 s); typewriter 5.77-7.00 s (~16 cps, 21 chars in 37 fr); band collapses to nothing by 7.27 (≤ 8 fr, easings.inExpo, ±0.25 s)

structure.shot: white frame: 2-word label on top, a thick green progress ring in the centre with a bold percent figure inside
structure.motion: after a 2 fr black flash at 7.37, label words fade in staggered (7.50 first, 7.77 both); ring fills 0 -> 100 % in 27 fr (7.50-8.40) on easings.inOutCubic (reference is steeper: 20 -> 78 % inside 3 fr), start 9 o'clock, counter-clockwise, butt caps, no track; counter is the same eased value; hold to 9.00; everything fades out by 9.27, white holds to the cut

structure.shot: black frame: 5-word headline and tiny subline on top, violet globe centre, 8 currency coins on a face-on circle around it
structure.motion: black band grows from mid-frame over white/grey to full frame 9.63-10.27 (~19 fr, springs.layout) as the globe rises; coins appear clockwise 1.3 fr apart 9.97-10.20, radius 0.89 -> 1.00 of 0.264 H; creep 1 deg/fr, then one in-out spin of ~107 deg over 53 fr (peak 9.5 deg/fr at 10.95), then 0.3-0.5 deg/fr drift; glyphs stay upright; coin glow ~8 px

structure.shot: white frame, black wordmark centred, about 18 % W
structure.motion: white panel wipes right to left over the orbit 11.73-12.13 (12 fr, easings.inOutCubic); wordmark letters swing in from the right end to the left 12.13-12.77 (~1-2 fr per letter, springs.snappy, overshoot not measurable); hold 40 fr to the end

params.brand: brand.json: display font, fg/bg for the light rows, one accent for the ring, one for the orbit coins and globe
params.content.listing: app name line and a subline of up to 6 words for the store strip, plus the action pill label
params.content.homeScreen: phone home screen rebuild: balance figure, 4 round actions, 2 list rows
params.content.card: payment card art: gradient stops, chip, small wordmark
params.content.chart: balance figure (start and end), delta line, 12-20 chart points, two small stat pairs
params.content.claim: one claim of about 3 words typed into the band
params.content.orbit: headline (about 5 words), subline, 8 short glyphs for the coins
params.timing.spin: orbit spin degrees and frames (default 107 deg over 53 fr)

notes: Measured: ring 0 -> 100 % in 27 fr, 20 -> 78 % inside 3 fr (steep in-out, no overshoot), start 9 o'clock ccw, r 0.21 H, stroke 0.19 r. Orbit face-on: r 0.264 H, coin 0.089 H, globe 0.23 H, 8 items at 45 deg, one 107 deg in-out spin over 53 fr then drift. The 7.37 flash is black, 2 fr (vocabulary flash used with a black colour). Each shot holds one idea and moves front-loaded, then holds. sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Proposed terms (not used here): card-flip-3d, band-open, letter-wipe-reveal.
